reviews.name: jameshealy
text: MacBar does exactly what it says: it tucks a clean system monitor into your menu bar and stays out of the way.
What stands out is the care behind the choices — it's free, open source, no subscriptions.
The design is genuinely nice, too. The icon is sharp and the readout is easy to read at a glance. For a lightweight utility, it hits the right balance: useful information without clutter.
Worth a look if you want a no-nonsense way to keep an eye on your Mac.
